title: Code to communicate with Accucheck Guide
symptom: The user wants to code communication with an Accucheck Guide glucose meter but cannot find the BLE part that handles it, and is unsure whether it uses Bluetooth or USB.
cause: The Accucheck Guide does not have the GLUCOSE CONTEXT characteristic, which causes the program to get stuck in the queue if not removed.
fix: In the BluetoothGlucoseMeter class, modify the list of characteristics to remove the GLUCOSE CONTEXT characteristic (similar to what was done for Diamond Mobile Mini), and use the command Bluetooth_CMD.write(GLUCOSE_SERVICE, RECORDS_CHARACTERISTIC, RecordsCmdTx.getAllRecords(), "request all readings") to get data.
evidence_quote: Problem is Accucheck don't have GLUCOSE CONTEXT characteristic. So we need to delete that., like they did for "Diamond Mobile Mini".
